text:
tina: Quick heads-up — I'm creating RC-2026-03-21-01 now. Artifact: sha=abcdef123. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need KV-warm plan and rollback criteria before we trigger deploybot.
praveen: ack. can you paste the artifact link? want to run a quick perf smoke on staging.
tina: link: https://ci.internal/artifacts/abcdef123 (build meta attached). smoke script: `./scripts/smoke.sh --rc abcdef123`
jen: tagging SRE for kv-warm/oom concerns — last RC hit coldstart p50 jump on embed-service. @alex fyi.
alex: looking. also need release notes blurb for the runtime kernel tweaks (attention-fusion). I'll draft.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] RC creation requested: rc_id=RC-2026-03-21-01, artifact=abcdef123, requested_by=tina. Preflight checks queued.
sre-bot: [sre-bot] Preflight results: lint=ok, infra-health=ok, kv-cache-warm=warn (cold start observed in canary replay).
praveen: what's kv-cache-warm warn mean? more details?
sre-bot: sample: embed-service p50 increased from 85ms->240ms when cold. Suggest KV prewarm step of 3 warm calls per model variant and 2x replica priming.
jen: ops-lifeboat plan proposal: a) canary 5% traffic in us-west1 b) run kv-prewarm job c) observe 30m telemetry d) promote if p95 < 600ms and error-rate < 0.5%
tina: +1. add rollback triggers: 1) p95 > 1200ms for 5m 2) error-rate > 1% for 3m 3) unseen model regressions in eval set (fail-by-name).
alex: release notes snippet: "runtime: attention-fusion kernels enabled for optimized long-context; expect 10-20% gen latency reduction; known caveat: initial warmup slower for large kv tables — we recommend KV prewarm."
praveen: started a staging smoke with the artifact now. logs: ```
./scripts/smoke.sh --rc abcdef123
[ok] basic gen
[p95] 220ms
[embed] prewarm required
```
jen: good. canary window timing? remember privacy team needs a heads-up for Dedicated customers (Private tier).
tina: emailing privacy right now. canary go at 02:15 UTC if staging looks green. deploybot call will be: `/deploy promote --rc RC-2026-03-21-01 --canary 5% --region us-west1 --kv-prewarm true`
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Deploy command queued by tina: `/deploy promote --rc RC-2026-03-21-01 --canary 5% --region us-west1 --kv-prewarm true` — waiting on manual approval from two owners (eng-release and oncall).
alex: i'm +1. jen, praveen can you both approve when you see staging metrics?
jen: approve (pending 30m observation). :white_check_mark:
praveen: approve after final metric check at +10m. doing perf comparisons now.
sre-bot: telemetry hook created: dashboard -> /dash/rc-2026-03-21-01, alert hooks for p95 and error-rate set. playbook pinned: https://wiki/internal/rc-playbooks/kv-prewarm.
tina: all set. i'll hit deploybot at 02:10 UTC for a 02:15 canary start. if anything trips, we roll back to pinned artifact: sha=abcdef122 (last-known-good).
praveen: one more note — feature-flag rollout: disable experimental token-cache in canary to reduce noise. add flag: `exp.token_cache=false`
tina: added flag to canary config. final checklist: artifact ok, privacy notified, kv-prewarm job ready, deploybot queued, approvals from alex/jen/praveen. going radio-silent 01:50-02:20 UTC. ping if emergency. :boat:
